title: Robinson Splitting Theorem and $Σ_1$ Induction
summary: The Robinson Splitting Theorem states that a c.e. degree $\mathbf{b}$ splits over any low c.e. degree $\mathbf{c}<\mathbf{b}$. We prove that a weaker version of this theorem holds in models of $\mathrm{P}^-+\mathrm{I}Σ_1$, with lowness replaced by superlowness.
